$comment: Owner-observed connectors for the navigation build (docs/research/terrain-navigation.md §11; D-031, D-034 items 1 and 2).
Only rows with status 'observed' are built, as directed off-mesh links (two when bidirectional); 'todo' rows change
nothing and are listed as missing by pnpm nav:validate. Endpoints are what /way shows in game: a UiMap and a percent
position; the uiMapId must be a UiMap of the row's map (RC-12). Seconds are read with a stopwatch. Boats and zeppelins
are TravelGraph transports, never rows here. A teleport row has castSeconds instead of rideSeconds. How to record one:
the design's §11.3 (about five minutes per connector). Still needed (§11.3): at least three Thunder Bluff elevators,
three Undercity elevators, the Rut'theran portal (and a return portal, if the game has one); the Great Lift is optional.

a.note: bottom landing, on the Mulgore ground

waitSeconds.note: longest wait seen for the platform to arrive

castSeconds.note: stepping in to control at the arrival, loading screen included
